parts.text: “…AI will probably, like, most likely sort of lead to the end of the world,
but in the meantime, there will be great companies…”

items._note: Integration v1: the recording turned up (research/verify/SUMMARY.md): Airbnb OpenAir 2015 fireside chat with Mike Curtis (re-upload d6lDZpvHAoo, clips/altman-airbnb-2015.mp3 527.8-537.3; 18 s excerpt clips/altman-2015-short.mp4 0.0-10.9). Verbatim heard: "(Um,) you know, I think AI will probably like most likely sort of lead to the end of the world, but in the meantime there will be great companies created with serious machine learning." (small.en on both files + the excerpt's burned-in captions agree). The card now quotes the recording, not Business Insider's tidied print version ("AI will probably most likely lead to the end of the world, but in the meantime, there'll be great companies.", BI Jun 4 2015); leading "…" = "you know, I think" trimmed, trailing "…" = "created with serious machine learning" trimmed. Kept as a card: the spoken line runs 4.4 s (7 s with the punchline) and the speech window (edit 0-11.4) is full. Jun 2015 = BI's report of the talk ("Thursday", dated Jun 4 2015); OpenAir is on Curtis's shirt in the footage.

caption.text: …there’s a 25% chance that things go really, really badly.

items._note: Footage per research/verify/amodei-video.json (Axios upload nvXj4HTiYqA).
